title: Budget Limit Crossing
purpose: Tests severe or moderate budget pressure, destination retries, hotel ceiling behavior, and whether the output explains budget compromise.

payload.group_notes: This must be as cheap as possible. Avoid expensive hotels, paid tours, and high-cost dining.
